Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 code violation count, left-joining tract counts to tracts so tracts with no recorded violations show zero, ordered by count descending then tract name.
sql:
WITH m1 AS (
  SELECT geoid, n
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_1748a0'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  COALESCE(m1.n, 0) AS code_violation_count,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN m1 ON t.geoid = m1.geoid
ORDER BY code_violation_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
